messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicorehealth.com>, Dr. Aaron Patel <apatel@medicorehealth.com>

Subject: Intro + MAP draft and who owns what (next steps)

Hi Samantha / Aaron —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get going. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and the evaluation checklist we discussed during the exec call. High level: we have three parallel streams we need to align on over the next 60 days:

- Security & compliance evidence (SOC2 + data flow diagrams) — procurement and security review
- Pilot evaluation (3-week feature + perf tests) — product & workflows, capture success metrics
- Production readiness (SLA, routing, support model) — ops and account team

I want to introduce your primary Redwood contacts so we have clear single points of ownership:
- Alex Martinez (me) — commercial lead, procurement coordinator, expedite any license questions
- Monica Patel — customer success manager, will lead onboarding, pilot plan, and success metrics
- Laura Bennett — technical program lead from Redwood; she’ll coordinate runbooks and pre-production validations

Monica / Laura — Samantha and Aaron are the two core stakeholders on the MediCore side. Samantha will coordinate procurement and scheduling; Aaron will own clinical evaluation and acceptance criteria.

Please see the attached MAP ("MediCore_MAP_v1.xlsx") with a proposed timeline and owners populated. Key asks for this week:
1) Samantha — confirm preferred dates for kickoff workshop (30–45 minute cadence check + pilot kickoff)
2) Aaron — confirm the three clinical scenarios you want included in the pilot evaluation (I listed the ones from the call)
3) Monica — please propose an onboarding cadence and the initial test data ingestion checklist

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock the kickoff date.

Attachments: MediCore_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Signed_SOW_0527.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Alex

Subject: Re: Intro + MAP draft and who owns what (next steps)

Hi all — quick note from the CS side to accept handoff and propose first-week plan.

Thanks Alex for the clear owners. Laura / Rafael — I’ve put together a compact onboarding plan that aligns with the MAP milestones; highlights below: 

Week 0 (pre-kickoff) — administrative checks
- SOW countersigned confirmed (Alex)
- DocuSign copy + billing contact (Samantha / Procurement)
- Access list for pilot environment (emails + service accounts)

Week 1 — kickoff & discovery (shop-floor to technical)
- 60–90 minute kickoff workshop: introductions, success metrics, data ingestion overview
- Technical intake: network allowlists, sample payloads, and retention policy

Week 2–4 — pilot execution
- Deploy pilot to dedicated test pool, run three clinical scenarios, capture latency and gold-standard comparisons
- Weekly sync (30 min) to review blockers and interim results

Acceptance & wrap (end of week 4)
- Acceptance criteria checklist, sign-off by Aaron
- Recommendations and production readiness playbook (SLOs, fallback policies)

I’m attaching a one-page onboarding checklist that I’ll use to track progress. I’ll own the pilot plan and weekly syncs; Laura will own the technical validations and perf acceptance tests. Rafael will be on-call for any infra escalations and region-specific routing work.

Action items this thread:
- Samantha: share preferred kickoff slots for next week (Mon/Tue/Thu mornings suggested)
- Aaron: confirm the three clinical scenarios and any test data constraints
- Laura: can you confirm test-pool capacity and if we need additional model variants pinned for the pilot?

Attaching: MediCore_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with CS milestones), Onboarding_Checklist_v1.pdf

— Monica

Thanks team — tagging in with technical kickoff items and a short checklist for the pre-kickoff window. I’ll lead runbook validation and perf acceptance for the pilot.

Pre-kickoff (before Apr 27):
- Network: please send allowlist IPs and expected egress CIDRs; we’ll validate with infra (Rafael)
- Test data: sanitized sample payloads (JSON lines) and representative sizes (max token lengths)
- Auth: confirm whether you prefer API key or mTLS for pilot access (we support both)
- Model config: we’ll pin a production-like variant and a quantized variant for cost vs perf comparisons

Pilot acceptance items (what I’ll validate):
- End-to-end latency under target (95th percentile < 400ms for the clinical extraction flow)
- Output fidelity: F1 on extraction tasks > threshold (we’ll add specifics after Aaron confirms scenarios)
- Stability: no more than 2 infra incidents during the 3-week run

I’ll upload a short-runbook to the shared Drive today (link above) and will create a calendar for weekly syncs after Alex confirms final attendee list. If we need additional model variants or increased test capacity I can spin up a small burst pool with Rafael.

See you on Apr 27 — I’ll bring a technical checklist to the kickoff and propose the first set of validation prompts.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Technical Program Lead
